text: You lost ten bucks. Still buying the ticket?
Picture it. You're at the theater. A ticket costs ten dollars.
You open your wallet, and a ten dollar bill is gone.
Researchers asked students. Would you still buy the ticket?
But change one thing. You already bought the ticket, and you lost the ticket.
Now only forty-six percent would buy another.
Your brain keeps money in separate jars. A second ticket feels like paying twenty.
So you lost ten bucks. Which ten was it?
